body:
That's actually an interesting bug I'd never noticed before. It is possible a change in the "normal" path had broken the reset path for client interpolation.

The problem is caused by `client_physics_interpolation_data->global_xform_curr` not being up to date at the time of the reset, it doesn't get updated until _after_ the physics tick, so it is resetting stale data. This probably needs a shortcut for when transform is changed during the tick so that reset will work correctly.

I'm guessing I must have broken client resetting at some point with an unrelated change, it shouldn't be too tricky to fix.

However, given that I'm currently reworking 3D physics interpolation in #103685 and the client interpolation will work quite differently, we'll have to decide whether to do interim fix or just wait until the new version is available in 4.x.
